record.title: DfCM EXPLORE latest
record.body: R75 non-dominated frontier adds an Ash/OCEL dual-RevOps structural factory with independent candidate surfaces for Domains, Resources, Relationships, Identities, Actions, Policies, Calculations, Aggregates, Validations, Reactor, LiveView, APIs, migrations, value calculators, opportunity/offer workspaces, OCEL evidence, consumer qualification, agent refinement, regeneration, and supersession. Exact-head factory workflow ALIVE; broader CI/vacuity pending at write time.
